items.claim: Genmab filed a Form 6-K setting out its Articles of Association as of 24 September 2026, which per the filing state a share capital of DKK 62,405,855 and a board authorisation running through 12 March 2029 to issue new shares, warrants and convertible debt up to specified nominal limits, with or without pre-emption rights.
items.source: Genmab A/S Form 6-K filing, as summarised by TipRanks

items.claim: Tahamtan Ahmadi, Executive Vice President og Chief Medical Officer i Genmab, sagde om fase 2-resultaterne for rinatabart sesutecan (Rina-S) i RAINFOL-01: 'The late-breaking results presented today add an important layer of evidence to the growing clinical experience with Rina-S in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.'
items.source: Tahamtan Ahmadi, EVP og Chief Medical Officer, Head of Experimental Medicines, Genmab, i selskabets meddelelse

items.claim: Studieinvestigator Elizabeth K. Lee, onkolog ved Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, udtalte i Genmabs meddelelse: 'The antitumor activity and durability observed with Rina-S in this heavily pretreated population are encouraging and suggest the potential to meaningfully impact outcomes for patients facing a particularly challenging stage of disease.'
items.source: Elizabeth K. Lee, M.D., studieinvestigator, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, citeret i Genmabs meddelelse

items.claim: Genmab offentliggjorde en storaktionaermeddelelse om, at Darwin Global Management Limited har oplyst at kontrollere aktier svarende til mere end 5 pct. af stemmerettighederne i Genmab gennem fonde og porteføljer under forvaltning, opgjort pr. 2026-09-28.
items.source: Genmab A/S, storaktionaermeddelelse efter kapitalmarkedslovens paragraf 30, baseret paa indberetning fra Darwin Global Management Limited
